title: NACG President & CEO Joe Lambert appears on BNN Bloomberg’s Morning Markets
summary: ACHESON, Alberta, August 2, 2023 – Joe Lambert, Chief Executive Officer of North American Construction Group, was a guest on BNN Bloomberg’s Morning Markets to discuss the acquisition of Australia’s MacKellar Group, a heavy contractor that shifts vast amounts of material for resource projects and civil engineering.
